---- MODULE ivy_examples_tlb ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_tlbDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

AgSendPC == {InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap,
  InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction,
  InitiatorInterrupt}
AgMiddlePC == AgSendPC \ {InitiatorForSend}
AgCheckedPC == AgMiddlePC \ {InitiatorCheckCpuPmap}
AgAfterPC == {InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb,
  InitiatorUnlockPmap}
AgPmapPC == AgSendPC \cup {InitiatorWaitForQuiescence} \cup AgAfterPC
AgInitLockPC == {InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction}
AgRespLockPC == {ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded,
  ResponderUnlockAction}
AgGoodPC == {Boot, MainCheck, MainChoose, InitiatorDeactivate}
AgActivePC == AgGoodPC \cup {MainHandleInterrupt, ResponderCheck,
  ResponderDeactivate}
AgAllPC == AgActivePC \cup AgPmapPC \cup AgRespLockPC \cup
  {InitiatorLockPmap, InitiatorReactivate, ResponderLockAction,
   ResponderReactivate}

AgTypes ==
  /\ pc \in [Processor -> AgAllPC]
  /\ userpmap \in [Processor -> PMap]
  /\ writepmap \in [Processor -> PMap]
  /\ actionlock \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ actionneeded \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ active \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ interrupt \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ currentcpu \in [Processor -> Processor]
  /\ plock \in [PMap -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ tlb \in [Processor -> PageEntry]
  /\ pentry \in [PMap -> PageEntry]
  /\ todo \in [Processor -> [Processor -> BOOLEAN]]
  /\ error \in BOOLEAN

AgActivity == \A p \in Processor : active[p] = (pc[p] \in AgActivePC)

AgPmapLocks ==
  /\ \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in AgPmapPC => plock[writepmap[p]]
  /\ \A p,q \in Processor :
       (pc[p] \in AgPmapPC /\ pc[q] \in AgPmapPC /\
        writepmap[p] = writepmap[q]) => p = q

AgActionLocks ==
  /\ \A p \in Processor :
       pc[p] \in AgRespLockPC => actionlock[p]
  /\ \A p \in Processor :
       pc[p] \in AgInitLockPC => actionlock[currentcpu[p]]
  /\ \A p,q \in Processor :
       (pc[p] \in AgInitLockPC /\ pc[q] \in AgInitLockPC /\
        currentcpu[p] = currentcpu[q]) => p = q
  /\ \A p \in Processor :
       pc[p] \in AgInitLockPC => pc[currentcpu[p]] \notin AgRespLockPC
  /\ \A q \in Processor : actionlock[q] =>
       (pc[q] \in AgRespLockPC \/
        \E p \in Processor : pc[p] \in AgInitLockPC /\ currentcpu[p] = q)

AgTargets ==
  /\ \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in AgMiddlePC =>
       (currentcpu[p] # p /\ pc[currentcpu[p]] # Boot)
  /\ \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in AgCheckedPC =>
       userpmap[currentcpu[p]] = writepmap[p]
  /\ \A p,q \in Processor :
       (pc[p] \in AgSendPC /\ todo[p][q]) => (q # p /\ pc[q] # Boot)

AgMarked == \A p \in Processor :
  pc[p] \in {InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt} =>
    (actionneeded[currentcpu[p]] /\ pc[currentcpu[p]] \notin AgRespLockPC)

AgNotified(q) ==
  /\ actionneeded[q]
  /\ pc[q] \notin AgRespLockPC
  /\ interrupt[q] \/ pc[q] \in {ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate,
                               ResponderLockAction}

AgSending == \A p,q \in Processor :
  (pc[p] \in AgPmapPC /\ q # p /\ pc[q] # Boot /\
   userpmap[q] = writepmap[p]) =>
    ( (pc[p] \in AgSendPC /\ todo[p][q])
      \/ (pc[p] \in AgMiddlePC /\ currentcpu[p] = q)
      \/ AgNotified(q) )

AgQuiescence == \A p,q \in Processor :
  ( (pc[p] \in AgAfterPC \/
     (pc[p] = InitiatorWaitForQuiescence /\ ~todo[p][q])) /\
    q # p /\ pc[q] # Boot /\ userpmap[q] = writepmap[p]) =>
      pc[q] \notin AgGoodPC

AgPending(q) ==
  /\ actionneeded[q]
  /\ interrupt[q] \/ pc[q] \in {ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate,
                               ResponderLockAction, ResponderRefreshTlb}

AgCoherence == \A q \in Processor :
  \/ pc[q] = Boot
  \/ tlb[q] = pentry[userpmap[q]]
  \/ (pc[q] \notin (AgGoodPC \cup {ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction}) /\ AgPending(q))
  \/ (pc[q] = InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb /\ userpmap[q] = writepmap[q])

AgInv == AgTypes /\ AgActivity /\ AgPmapLocks /\ AgActionLocks /\
  AgTargets /\ AgMarked /\ AgSending /\ AgQuiescence /\ AgCoherence /\ ~error

USE DEF Boot, MainCheck, MainChoose, MainHandleInterrupt, InitiatorDeactivate, InitiatorLockPmap, InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap, InitiatorReactivate, ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate, ResponderLockAction, ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction, ResponderReactivate, AgSendPC, AgMiddlePC, AgCheckedPC, AgAfterPC, AgPmapPC, AgInitLockPC, AgRespLockPC, AgGoodPC, AgActivePC, AgAllPC

  <1>2. (AgActivity)'

    <2>2. (AgActionLocks!2)'

    <2>3. (AgActionLocks!3)'

    <2>4. (AgActionLocks!4)'
      BY SMTT("r3") DEF HandleInterrupt, AgInv, AgTypes, AgPmapLocks, AgActionLocks, AgTargets
    <2>5. (AgActionLocks!5)'
      <3>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW q \in Processor, actionlock'[q]
             PROVE pc'[q] \in AgRespLockPC \/
               \E i \in Processor : pc'[i] \in AgInitLockPC /\ currentcpu'[i] = q
        BY DEF AgActionLocks
      <3>2. CASE pc'[q] \in AgRespLockPC

        <4>2. pc'[i] \in AgInitLockPC /\ currentcpu'[i] = q

        <4>3. QED BY <4>1, <4>2

                 /\ ~(\E i \in Processor : pc[i] \in AgInitLockPC /\ currentcpu[i] = q)

          BY <3>1, <3>4, SMTT("r3") DEF HandleInterrupt, AgInv, AgTypes, AgActionLocks
        <4>2. QED BY <4>1
